AC4 and AC2 are also partly backend-only and do not show the empty or error states of the report page.","suggested_fix":"Remove the duplicated words and add an AC for the report table loading and error state if it is in scope."},{"check_id":"CRIT-CONSTRAINT","severity":"warning","item_key":"US-view-task-report","requirement_ids":["R-9dc414dc"],"message":"The story's tasks call the read-all and metrics endpoints, but no AC covers what the page shows when the backend fails, and the PRD requires internal server and database errors to be handled.","suggested_fix":"Add an AC: Given the metrics or read-all request fails, When the report page loads, Then an error message is shown and no metric values are shown."}]}
